server: Local app restarted on port 8000 and health checked; server left running.
changes: Field coordinates are applied immediately; an independent frozen map snapshot is captured afterward. Late snapshots cannot overwrite revised marks. Screenshot capture is bounded to three seconds.
Only the latest client estimate can update results. HTTP disconnects cancel the corresponding queued/running server estimate cooperatively; durable saves are not cancelled by disconnects.
The app worker prewarms encoder selection and flight math. Its verified encoder choice is passed into render subprocesses instead of probing per export.
Frame-accurate raw source preparation is shared between rendering and final save. Both original and rendered videos remain durably stored in the database before acknowledging save.
The worker consistently uses the bundled FFmpeg/FFprobe binaries, including desktop unpacked paths. The bundled encoder successfully uses Intel Quick Sync on this machine.
The existing fixed-step flight equations run in a compiled kernel with fastmath disabled. Python fallback remains available. Existing NumPy and SciPy versions were preserved.

validation.source_contact_alignment: Contact is 1.0 seconds into the prepared raw clip; best matching original-frame offset is zero.
validation.coverage: Compiled/Python equation equivalence across speeds, launch angles, spin and wind; missing-accelerator fallback; runtime reload/recovery; queued and running cancellation; source and encoder reuse/retry; save persistence in a temporary database; rejected-export guards; current/stale/timed-out map capture; auto accept, manual reject, detection failure and cancellation branches; explicit render once; full hardware replay/metrics/map/flight/results/audio export.

limits: These timings are individual local runs, not guaranteed response times. Fresh estimates and complete rendering still take time on this two-core machine. This change does not implement cloud offloading, browser-side rendering, reduced-quality export, or speculative field landmark detection.
raw_test_evidence: demo-output/speed-benchmark/fresh-input.json contains the durable copy of the same raw Cortland observations; saved predictions are used only to compare results after inference.
